These stripes are usually seen at a cuffed pant leg or at the top edge of a coin pocket. Although subtle, once you're aware of it, you'll start to notice it and the range of colors that these stripes come in. This stripe can vary but traditionally it's a white stripe with a red line running through it.

Our classic painter's pants, constructed from authentic 10oz Japanese herringbone twill — a fabric rooted in traditional workwear and renowned for the durability provided by its distinctive zig-zag weave. Woven with uneven yarns to add texture and heft, this herringbone utilises rope-dyed indigo warp yarns and a white weft — so like our hickory stripe and Wabash fabrics, you can expect these pants to fade and evolve with subtle vintage character as you put them to work. With features including reinforced belt loops, triple-stitch construction, multiple pockets and a tool loop, these are hardwearing and practical work pants that deliver authentic heritage style.

Our brown greased suede hiking boots are inspired by mountain life. Built to be solid and enveloping ankle boots, to accompany you on your winter days: between the lining and the leather there is a membrane that increases its water resistance; and there are no openings on the tongue: it is a single piece, so you can keep the rain at bay. Adorned with shoelaces in two colours and visible stitching, they blend perfectly with the Vibram rubber sole. A jaunt in the snow, corduroy trousers in warm tones, a blue turtleneck under a denim shirt and a checked jacket.
Made in Montegranaro (Italy)

They are made with you in mind; a connoisseur who wants footwear that’s timeless - in all senses of the word.
